title: noob character { should play on guest, clientsided }
script:
if game.Players.LocalPlayer.Character:FindFirstChild("Spray paint") then
if game.Players.LocalPlayer.Character:FindFirstChild("Pants") then
game.Players.LocalPlayer.Character.Pants:Destroy()
end
if game.Players.LocalPlayer.Character:FindFirstChild("Shirt") then
game.Players.LocalPlayer.Character.Shirt:Destroy()
end
game.Players.LocalPlayer.Character.Torso.BrickColor = BrickColor.new("Bright blue")
game.Players.LocalPlayer.Character.Head.BrickColor = BrickColor.new("Bright yellow")

game.Players.LocalPlayer.Character.Robloxclassicred.Handle.Mesh.MeshId = "rbxassetid://5164192195"

game.Players.LocalPlayer.PlayerGui.Healthbars.Screen.Playerframe.Icon.Guest.Robloxclassicred.Handle.Mesh.MeshId = "rbxassetid://5164192195"
game.Players.LocalPlayer.PlayerGui.Healthbars.Screen.Playerframe.Icon.Guest.Robloxclassicred.Handle.Mesh.TextureId = "rbxassetid://5163760056"
